records.title: Creative futures fellowship
records.summary: A six-month fellowship for independent writers and visual storytellers exploring the future of creative work. Includes mentorship and a $12,000 stipend.

records.title: Stories that move us
records.summary: An open call for original essays about community, belonging, and the places that shape us. Selected work receives a $2,500 commission.

records.title: The independent voices grant
records.summary: Project funding for emerging journalists working on underreported stories. Grants of up to $8,000 support research, travel, and production.

records.title: A month in the mountains
records.summary: A fully funded residency for writers seeking time and space to develop a new body of work. Accommodation and studio access included.

records.title: Dispatches from tomorrow
records.summary: Pitch a reported feature on the ideas changing everyday life. We welcome fresh perspectives and first-time contributors.

records.title: Summer editorial internship
records.summary: A paid editorial internship supporting long-form stories, research, and the weekly newsletter. This application cycle has closed.

record.title: Bellingcat — Online Masterclass in Visual Intelligence: The Art of Advanced Geolocation
record.summary: Advanced eight-hour masterclass (EUR 700, Sept 29-30, 2026) on solving difficult geolocation cases with no obvious landmarks, using structured investigative frameworks that combine satellite, environmental, and social evidence with AI-assisted verification. Applicants submit a short pre-assessment describing a prior geolocation attempt.

record.title: Journalism Trust Initiative (JTI) Certification Grant
record.summary: CIJI/Reporters Without Borders grant covering the cost of a Journalism Trust Initiative (JTI) certification audit. Up to 6 grants of €1,500-€5,000 each, based on actual audit cost. Applicants must be a legally registered media organization in an EU-27 member state, have completed and published their JTI self-assessment/transparency report, and be committed to pursuing full JTI certification. Funded by the European Union.

record.title: Bellingcat — How to Start Your Career in Open Source Investigations
record.summary: Low-cost (EUR 50), two-hour career-focused webinar (live Oct 2, 2026) led by Bellingcat's Director of Research and Training, walking through practical steps to break into the OSINT/open-source investigations field. Suited to early-career journalists and researchers.
